subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the given figures when placed in the 5th position would continue the series that is established by the first four figures? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b1bad286d236513ec70dc2b3d32c45fd97df0cc385c155e0c42a844368a16c5.png]
solution:
Option 3 figure when placed in the 5th position would continue the series that is established by the first four figures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/140dd5f01771057f77498e8dbaad814b4be57f683c90d906fd0a1ebcd8bef076.png] 

How square and triangle shape shift their position in the series is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b248fa61aec5629cbdda47bc00256d9f9600f2559943ee8053c335faaeceaf1.png] '

Arrow shape at the centre of the series is facing towards north in the figures at odd position, and facing south in the figures at even position.

Hence, ‘**option 3**’ is the correct answer.
